growback.rule: Resources regrow by regrowth_rate per step up to cell capacity

move_welfare.rule: Move to the empty cell within vision that maximizes Cobb-Douglas welfare

move_tiebreak.rule: Among best cells prefer the nearest (euclidean, 1% tolerance), then random

welfare.rule: Cobb-Douglas welfare with exponents from relative metabolism

metabolism.rule: Agents consume metabolism_sugar / metabolism_spice each step

death.rule: Agents die when sugar or spice reaches zero

vision.rule: Heterogeneous vision radius bounds movement and trade neighbourhoods

trade.rule: Bilateral trade with neighbours within vision, repeated while beneficial

mrs_stop.rule: Trading stops when the post-trade MRSs would cross

price_rule.rule: Price is the geometric mean of the two MRSs; integer bundle sizes

heterogeneity.rule: Endowments, metabolisms and vision drawn per agent from uniform ranges

two_goods.rule: Two complementary goods (sugar and spice) with mirrored landscapes

random_activation.rule: Agents act in a freshly shuffled order each phase

mesa_framework.rule: Mesa Model/AgentSet/Cell/PropertyLayer machinery (counted in complexity via tracing)

control_landmarks.name: numpy_reimplementation
control_landmarks.doc: independent plain-numpy implementation of the same rules (no Mesa)

control_landmarks.name: rng_reorder
control_landmarks.doc: same rules, different dice: trait draws reordered and model seed remixed

control_landmarks.name: ko_no_trade
control_landmarks.doc: trade rule T removed (agents never exchange)

control_landmarks.name: ko_random_move
control_landmarks.doc: movement rule M replaced by a random empty cell within vision

control_landmarks.name: ko_uniform_vision
control_landmarks.doc: vision fixed at 1 regardless of the vision inputs

control_landmarks.name: ko_ignore_population
control_landmarks.doc: always starts 200 agents whatever initial_population says

control_landmarks.name: ko_ignore_regrowth
control_landmarks.doc: resources always regrow 1 unit per step whatever regrowth_rate says

control_landmarks.name: ko_ignore_vision
control_landmarks.doc: vision always drawn from Mesa's default 1-5 whatever the vision inputs say

control_landmarks.name: ko_ignore_metabolism
control_landmarks.doc: metabolisms always drawn from Mesa's default 1-5 whatever the metabolism inputs say

control_landmarks.name: ko_ignore_endowment
control_landmarks.doc: endowments always drawn from Mesa's default 25-50 whatever the endowment inputs say

control_landmarks.name: ko_trade_always
control_landmarks.doc: agents trade even when enable_trade is false (the trade switch is ignored)

control_landmarks.name: null_random_walk
control_landmarks.doc: random walkers with multiplicative random wealth; no resources, no interaction

control_landmarks.name: null_noise_exchange
control_landmarks.doc: one exchange per encounter at a random price, with no welfare or MRS check (noise trading)

control_landmarks.name: ko_no_mrs_stop
control_landmarks.doc: MRS-crossing stop removed from the trade rule

control_landmarks.name: null_random_price
control_landmarks.doc: random price unrelated to MRS, but trades still need both parties better off (zero-intelligence traders with a budget constraint, Gode & Sunder 1993)
